name: Konose Hami
source: Hami is the childhood friend of Zenichi. As his childhood friend and the granddaughter of the school headmaster, this cliche character is considered a “deredere” character, or someone who is helplessly in love with the protagonist. Obviously, this characteristic is not explained throughout the story, and most of Hami’s route involves being bewildered by Zenichi’s actions in the most exaggerated manner.
